caption: Measured interval per transaction class and arm, over all 22 grouped runs. For READ and the SELECT phase of SBO the interval is the cross-layer response time; for OPERATE it is the master-visible ACK-to-echo interval. Boxes span the quartiles and the whiskers span the full observed range, so the late-arrival tail is visible rather than suppressed. The ordinate is logarithmic. Sample sizes are given per panel.
